title: Microflow Templar: heuristic templating + fallback scoring for automated admin fixes
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build a reusable "microflow templar" service that converts common admin remediation scenarios into parameterized microflow templates, scores candidate microflows with a multi-factor fallback scorer, and surfaces a human-in-loop approval UI plus automatic safe-execution paths. Goal: reduce mean time to repair for frequent incidents while keeping blast radius and risk auditable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Template library accepts new microflow definitions via YAML and validates idempotency rules
Fallback scorer computes a normalized risk score (0-100) combining success_rate, blast_radius, regression_risk, and confidence and returns top-3 ranked candidates
Safe-exec path enforces policy: confidence>=85 and canary_enabled OR requires approval if confidence between 60-85
All executions are logged with replayable snapshot and can be rolled back via undo tokens
E2E test harness simulates 30 synthetic incidents and achieves >=70% autopilot reduction in operator time compared to manual remediation baseline
technical_notes: Scorer components: telemetry-derived success_rate (weighted by recency), blast_radius heuristic (resource scope + permissions), regression_risk (modelled from past regressions), latency_penalty, cost_estimate.

Template language: subset YAML with typed params, pre/post checks, idempotency token, and declared side-effects. We'll reuse parts of RUNLET grammar from ENG-531999 but keep simpler runtime semantics.
Execution engine: sandboxed containerized executor with capability tokens and step-level timeouts. Support dry-run, simulate, and execute modes.
Safety gating: integrate RBAC with admin-policy service; require KMS-signed approval for high-privilege microflows.
Telemetry: augment ops-telemetry with microflow outcome events (outcome, duration, errors, snapshot hash) and create a scorer-training dataset in BigQuery.
Performance: scoring must run <200ms for real-time UI ranking; use cached aggregates refreshed every 5 minutes.
Privacy: scrub PII from snapshots; use k-anonymization and retention policy 90 days for replay snapshots.
ML note: future work could replace heuristic weights with a lightweight ranking model (LR) trained on outcome labels; initial rollout uses hand-tuned weights and AB tests.
Rollback/undo: every executed microflow emits an undo token that stores reverse steps; keep safety TTL and limit undo to last 2 hours for stateful infra actions.
